## Cerebras Shares Plunge ~20% After Earnings Miss; Hardware Sales Drop as AI Cloud Revenue Climbs 281%

The hardware-to-cloud mix shift is a pivotal signal: if Cerebras' wafer-scale differentiation is transitioning to a cloud-access model, the competitive surface shifts from hardware procurement to cloud provider competition — changing the unit economics timeline and the set of incumbents Cerebras must displace.

- Cerebras (CBRS) shares dropped nearly 20% after missing earnings expectations.
- Hardware sales declined in the reported period.
- AI cloud revenue grew 281%, indicating a material mix shift from direct hardware toward cloud-delivered access.
- The combination of an earnings miss and a hardware-to-cloud revenue pivot drove the sharp negative reaction.
